communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.61 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: VALUE does reach CD records (§2002:13.16.61.3 GR4 names the communication section; only the first redefinition may carry VALUE, §2002:A.1.2.2 SR9), through format 1 as a data-item value. GR11 is the screen-item sentence of format 1 (§2002:13.16.61.3 GR11) and a CD record item is not a screen item, so this rule has no CD reach; screen section declined at --std 2002.
